_how_to_edit: One entry per public sale. Leave a number as null if it is not known. hammer_basis is 'published' when a database or house states it, or 'calculated' when it was worked back from the total using the buyer's premium. After editing, run: python3 tools/build.py Each sale has an id that names its artwork entry on the artist's page (artists/<artist>/#work-<id>). Never change an id once used. A sale can carry image: {file, alt, credit}, with the file in assets/images/works/. A sale can carry mutualart: {url, est_low, est_high, price, price_basis, lot, checked}. It holds figures taken from the MutualArt sale record only where the house page we used does not give them. They are shown labelled 'From MutualArt' and never replace a house figure. price_basis is 'hammer' or 'premium' only when MutualArt states it, otherwise null.
